plainTranslation: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of how freely you present yourself and enter situations.

policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of how freely you present yourself and enter situations. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
